name: The Talko Bell
why_it_matters: Currently Vaishali's top-ranked restaurant on TripAdvisor — set in landscaped grounds with a pond, ducks and on-site livestock that doubles as the dining-room view. Multi-cuisine kitchen built around the Buddhist-Jain pilgrim circuit traffic (Lichchhavi capital, Mahavira's birthplace).
insider_tip: Vaishali is a thin restaurant town — outside Talko Bell, options drop to roadside dhabas. For a sit-down meal, stop here on the way in or out from Hajipur.
